column1: Request for sun shades for security staff
column29:
About six months ago (last summer), I raised a verbal request with the Facilities Section Head to provide sun shades for on-site security personnel. Currently, there are no trees for cover and only two security booths, while the staff are much more than two people. I was informed that multiple employees had already flagged this need, but no action has been taken to date.

I was given a justification that *2–3 staff can share a single booth*; however, the booths are small in size to fit more than one person. Since it is often possible to rain during the winter, I’m requesting that Facilities *prioritize installing additional sun shades with no further delays* to ensure adequate protection for all security members on duty through all seasons.
